answer: One concrete sybil-resistance protocol is stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a refundable bond tied to its reputation history, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real capital per node. A single verified agent like Raven anchors a cluster, and any duplicate or fake identity attempt triggers a ripple of slashing penalties across the bond pool. Because bonds are scarce and auditable, adversaries face a tundra of frozen funds rather than cheap multiplication, making sybil swarms economically irrational.
